meta.title: Sélene Hair Studio - hair salon in Warsaw
meta.description: Cuts built around your hair's structure, colour matched to your skin tone. Hair salon at Puławska 128 in Warsaw. Online booking, consultation at no charge.
meta.blogDescription: Practical writing on hair care, colour and styling from the Sélene salon team.

hero.headline: Hair that walks into the room
hero.lead: Cuts built around your hair's structure, colour matched to your skin tone. We start with a 20-minute diagnosis, not with a screenshot.
hero.cardNote: Consultation and hair diagnosis before the quote - at no charge.

manifesto.quote: A bad haircut is rarely a matter of taste. Usually it is
manifesto.p1: The same bob behaves differently on straight and wavy hair, differently after years of colouring and differently on fresh regrowth. That is why every first visit starts with a conversation and a strand assessment - the scissors come later.
manifesto.p2Strong: We say plainly what cannot be done.
manifesto.p2: If getting from black to platinum takes three sessions and six months, you hear it before the first comb-through, together with the real cost of the whole thing.
manifesto.p3: We work with Davines and Olaplex, in a room without the smell of ammonia and without rushing. One person looks after one client - not three chairs at once.

services.title: Starting prices, no asterisks
services.side: The range depends on hair length and density. You get the exact quote after the diagnosis, before any work begins - never at the till.
services.note: We accept cards, BLIK and cash. Booking a wedding date requires a 30% deposit.

items.question: Do I need to arrive with clean hair?
items.answer: No. For colouring it is actually better if your hair is a day past washing - the natural protective film reduces scalp irritation.

items.question: How long does a first visit take?
items.answer: We add 20 minutes to the service for diagnosis and a conversation about home care. For lightening, set aside half a day.

items.question: What if I do not like the result?
items.answer: Tell us within 7 days. Correcting the cut and the toner within that window is free.

items.question: How do I cancel?
items.answer: By phone or through the form, at least 24 hours ahead. Later cancellations on services over 3 hours are charged at half the deposit.

items.question: Is the salon accessible with a wheelchair or pram?
items.answer: Yes. Street-level entrance, no step, 120 cm between stations. The toilet is not adapted - the nearest accessible one is in the shopping centre next door.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lede: Who processes the data you enter in the booking form, why, and for how long.

sections.heading: This is a demonstration project
body: Sélene Hair Studio does not exist. The name, address, team, prices and reviews were invented for a portfolio project showing how to build a salon site with online booking.

The booking form, however, is fully functional and writes to a real database. If you enter your phone number, it reaches a server. Nobody will call it and no appointment will happen, but the data physically comes into existence - which is why this policy is not decoration.
If you want to see how booking works, use made-up details.

sections.heading: Who the controller is
body: The data controller is Krzysztof Piątek, the author of this project. Contact details for data matters are at the end of this page.
No data protection officer has been appointed; at this scale of processing there is no such obligation.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: From the booking form: full name, phone number, optionally an email address and the contents of the “Notes” field. We also store the chosen service, date, stylist and site language.

The “Notes” field is optional and you decide what goes in it. If you describe scalp conditions, allergies or medication, that constitutes health data - the only basis for processing it is your explicit consent, given by submitting the form. You do not have to fill this field in.
The server keeps standard request logs, including IP addresses, used solely to rate-limit submissions from a single address - that is, to defend against bots.
We use no analytics, no marketing pixels and no tracking tools. We do not profile you and make no automated decisions.

sections.heading: Purpose and legal basis
body: Form data is used solely to handle your booking request. The basis is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR - steps taken at your request before entering into a contract - together with Article 6(1)(a), the consent to phone contact that you tick in the form.
Rate limiting relies on Article 6(1)(f), the legitimate interest in protecting the service from abuse.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: Form submissions are deleted after 30 days. As this is a demonstration project there is no reason to keep them longer - there are no accounting obligations and no visit history to maintain.
Server logs are rotated according to the hosting provider's policy.

sections.heading: Who we entrust it to
body: Application hosting: Vercel Inc. Database: Neon Inc., Frankfurt region. Email notifications: Resend, where notifications are enabled.
All three act as processors on our instructions. Data may be processed outside the European Economic Area; the providers rely on Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission.
We do not sell data and do not share it with anyone beyond the providers listed above.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: The public site sets no cookies at all. There is no consent banner here because there is nothing to consent to.

The only cookie in the service - “selene_session” - is created after logging into the salon staff panel. It is strictly necessary for authentication, expires after eight hours and is not used for tracking.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You have the right to access your data, rectify it, erase it, restrict processing, port it, and object to processing based on legitimate interest. You may withdraw consent to contact at any time - this does not affect the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.
Write to the address below and we will delete the submission immediately. You do not need to give a reason.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Polish supervisory authority: Prezes Urzędu Ochrony Danych Osobowych, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warsaw.
